title: ¡Rojito perdió sus ruedas! 🚒😱 | Canciones Infantiles #Shorts
world: bright toy town sandbox park (green hills, sandy play road, blue sky) + toy garage workshop with wheels on the wall

hero.who: The little red fire truck character
hero.one: Only one vehicle character in the picture.

story: Rojito drives happily, BUM! his wheels fall off and roll away (problem)
He tries square wheels: clunk clunk bump (wrong 1)
He tries tiny wheels: wobble wobble (wrong 2)
He tries giant monster wheels: way too tall, uy! (wrong 3)
In the garage he finds round red wheels that fit (the fix)
Vroom! He drives fast and happy on the play road (reward)
Nee-naw! Siren on, he sprays a rainbow of water (climax)
One wheel rolls away again, uy! (loop gag)
lyrics:
[Intro]
¡Bum! ¡Rojito sin ruedas!
[Verse]
¿Ruedas cuadradas? ¡Tun, tun, tun!
¿Ruedas chiquitas? ¡No, no, no!
¿Ruedas gigantes? ¡Uy, qué alto!
[Chorus]
¡Ruedas redondas! ¡Sí, sí, sí!
¡Vroom, vroom, a rodar!
¡Nii-noo, nii-noo!
[Outro]
¡Rojito al rescate!
style: High-end 3D animated preschool cartoon style, soft rounded toy-like shapes, smooth matte clay-like materials, soft studio lighting with a warm key light, pastel but saturated colors, big expressive glossy eyes, cute and friendly, clean composition, high quality render.
lock: ROJITO, a cute little red toy fire truck character with a friendly face: a short chubby rounded body like a toddler toy, shiny cherry-red paint, a big curved windshield with two big glossy dark-brown cartoon eyes with white sparkle highlights and expressive eyebrows, a small smiling mouth on the front bumper, rosy pink cheeks on the front, a small white ladder on the roof, one round blue siren light on top, a golden bell on the front, a small number 1 in a yellow circle on each door.

locations.parque: A bright toy town sandbox park, vertical 9:16 composition, camera low at toy level: a smooth sandy play road curving between soft green rounded hills, small colorful toy traffic cones, a little wooden toy bridge, round cartoon trees, a bright blue sky with fluffy white clouds. No vehicles on the road.
locations.taller: A cheerful toy garage workshop, vertical 9:16 composition, camera low at toy level: a wall with hooks holding many different wheels (square wheels, tiny wheels, giant black monster truck wheels, and round red wheels), a red toolbox, a small car lift, warm light from a big open garage door showing green hills outside. No vehicles in the garage.

shots: Low side view at ground level on the sandy play road: the little red fire truck character bounces and all four of his black wheels pop off at once and fly away in different directions in a puff of sand, his body dropping to the ground, his eyes wide with shock.
The four wheels pop off and roll away in all directions, he drops to the sand.

Close-up from the front: the little red fire truck character sitting flat on the sand with NO wheels at all, empty wheel arches, looking sad with big teary eyes, one black wheel rolling away in the background.
He sighs and blinks sadly as a wheel rolls away behind him.
Side view: the little red fire truck character standing on four big yellow SQUARE blocks with corners instead of wheels, tilted and bumping, a funny determined face.
He bumps forward clunk clunk on the square blocks, rocking up and down.

Close-up three-quarter view from the front: the little red fire truck character standing on four TINY blue wheels as small as buttons, his body almost touching the ground, wobbling, with a nervous wobbly smile.
He wobbles left and right on the tiny wheels and shakes.
Very low angle from the ground looking up: the little red fire truck character lifted very high on four GIANT black monster truck wheels taller than him, swaying, looking down dizzy, blue sky behind.
He sways high on the giant wheels and blinks down dizzily.

Wide shot of the toy garage workshop: the little red fire truck character rolls toward a wall full of different wheels and looks up; four round shiny red wheels hang on a hook at the center, a sparkle on them.
His eyes light up as he looks at the round red wheels, a sparkle twinkles.

Tracking side view on the sandy play road: the little red fire truck character with four round shiny red wheels zooms fast from left to right, motion lines of sand dust behind, cones flying past, laughing.
He zooms along the road from left to right, wheels spinning fast, sand dust trailing.

Medium shot from the front: the happy little red fire truck character with round red wheels sprays a big arc of water from the hose on his roof into the sky, making a bright rainbow, his blue siren light glowing.
Water sprays in an arc and a rainbow appears, the siren light flashes.
twist: three wrong wheels (square, tiny, giant) — the kids shout NO each time; the right ones are the round red ones in the garage
